blocks.rationale: Jointly add two narrowly scoped statutory applicability classifiers that directly address the two SARA trigger failures, plus a reusable airline aggregation helper that avoids the repeatedly unreadable composite schedule fields by reading itemized current-bag charges. The helpers preserve native answer types and are semantically specific enough to avoid displacing unrelated history tasks.

inputs.name: individual_is_dependent_of_another_taxpayer
inputs.question: For the current taxable year, is the individual named in the proposition a dependent of another taxpayer, including by being that taxpayer's qualifying child or qualifying relative?

inputs.name: proposition_asserts_rule_applies
inputs.question: Does the current proposition assert that section 152(b)(1) applies to the named individual for the stated year?

skill.intent: Classify whether section 152(b)(1) applies to an individual who is a dependent of another taxpayer in the relevant calendar year.

outputs.description: The native binary label Entailment or Contradiction.
outputs.name: answer

fields.name: individual_is_dependent_of_another_taxpayer

fields.name: proposition_asserts_rule_applies
fields.question: Does the proposition assert that section 152(b)(1) applies?

reads.question: Read the current dependency relationships and the polarity of the section 152(b)(1) proposition for the stated taxable year.

origin.quote: For purposes of this subtitle, the term "dependent" means- (1) a qualifying child, or (2) a qualifying relative.

source_obligations.statement: Treat an individual who is another taxpayer's qualifying child or qualifying relative as that taxpayer's dependent.

origin.quote: If an individual is a dependent of a taxpayer for any taxable year of such taxpayer beginning in a calendar year, such individual shall be treated as having no dependents for any taxable year of such individual beginning in such calendar year.

source_obligations.statement: Return Entailment when the proposition's assertion matches the rule that a dependent of another taxpayer is treated as having no dependents in the corresponding calendar year.

source_provenance.quote: For purposes of this subtitle, the term "dependent" means- (1) a qualifying child, or (2) a qualifying relative.

If an individual is a dependent of a taxpayer for any taxable year of such taxpayer beginning in a calendar year, such individual shall be treated as having no dependents for any taxable year of such individual beginning in such calendar year.

skill.intent: Classify whether the dependent limitation in section 63(c)(5) applies to the current individual's basic standard deduction.

origin.quote: In the case of an individual with respect to whom a deduction under section 151 is allowable to another taxpayer for a taxable year beginning in the calendar year in which the individual's taxable year begins

source_obligations.statement: Determine whether a section 151 deduction for the current individual is allowable to another taxpayer in the corresponding calendar year.

origin.quote: the basic standard deduction applicable to such individual for such individual's taxable year shall not exceed the greater of- (A) $500, or (B) the sum of $250 and such individual's earned income.

source_obligations.statement: Section 63(c)(5) applies only when its condition that another taxpayer may take the section 151 deduction is satisfied; compare that result with the proposition.

source_provenance.quote: In the case of an individual with respect to whom a deduction under section 151 is allowable to another taxpayer for a taxable year beginning in the calendar year in which the individual's taxable year begins, the basic standard deduction applicable to such individual for such individual's taxable year shall not exceed the greater of- (A) $500, or (B) the sum of $250 and such individual's earned income.

origin.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.

source_obligations.statement: Apply the one-personal-item and one-carry-on allowances and their dimension limits before assigning checked-bag charges.

origin.quote: All published bag fees apply at each check-in location and are base rates according to travel dates and destination; applicable taxes are not shown.

source_obligations.statement: Include the published checked-bag base rate matching the current route, cabin, and checked-bag ordinal, including applicable complimentary treatment.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: When a checked bag is both overweight and oversize, include only the higher of those excess charges in addition to its checked-bag fee.

origin.quote: More than one fee may apply per bag that exceeds standard dimensions for both weight and size.

source_obligations.statement: Add every complete current-bag charge to the stated ticket price and return the exact integer total.
